about: #4628: each surviving det-port mutant stated `equivalent` or `unreachable`, with the Java change and why it cannot alter observable behaviour; proposed in a PR, reviewed by the owner. A run that kills a stated mutant fails (the claim was wrong). Ids are mutation.py's; before / after are the Java line.

verdicts.equivalent: the change cannot alter anything the program shows (output, screen, files, COMMAREA, abend)
verdicts.unreachable: no input of the program reaches the changed code
verdicts.harness-gap: the change alters behaviour the proof runs but does not compare (open: the harness must)
verdicts.case-gap: an input the case lacks would kill it (open: strengthen the case)

Goback's constructor without super(null, null, false, false): the default constructor only also records a stack trace; nothing reads the exception but its type

perform() reaches this only after a paragraph that is not its range's last returns, or for a GO TO; COUSR01C's PERFORMs of single paragraphs (from == thru) return at `i == thru`, it has no GO TO or THRU, and MAIN-PARA (runTask's perform(0, 8), the one multi-paragraph range) always ends in RETURN / XCTL / an abend, so no paragraph falls through, the outer-PERFORM scan never iterates, no PerformExit is thrown and the stack never grows (it nests a handful of paragraphs deep, not 64)

f178_ERRMSGO is overwritten with LOW_VALUES on line 839 when entering for the first time, and overwritten with WS-MESSAGE on line 979 before sending the map (the only place ERRMSGO is ever read), making this initial space-fill completely dead
PERFORM RETURN-TO-PREV-SCREEN THRU SEND-USRADD-SCREEN: RETURN-TO-PREV-SCREEN ends in its XCTL -- NORMAL ends the program, any other answer abends (no HANDLE) -- so the range end is never reached

`CDEMO-TO-PROGRAM = LOW-VALUES AND = SPACES` for OR: both callers of RETURN-TO-PREV-SCREEN move a program name into CDEMO-TO-PROGRAM first ('COSGN00C' at EIBCALEN = 0, 'COADM01C' on PF3), so it is neither, and both conditions are false
